comment.content:
A common way of detecting submarines from altitude is magnetic detection. Basically a plane with a big antenna flies over the water like a metal detector and when they get a signal they drop depth charges. Been a thing since WW2.

The operating area of a sub isn't going to be huge and after a couple attacks the area will be defined. Sweep that area with planes and in a few days they'll find the sub. And the only true value of a sub is being undetected. Repeat for any pirates. 

Now, submerged metal body decoys in a large enough area that also had underwater caves with air as discreet harbors would be something...
